dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged dark perimeters surrounding lighter interior pixels. Most prominent structures are located in the upper-mid dorsal region, exhibiting non-uniform 'O' and 'C' shapes with high-contrast gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of low-intensity (dark) solid pixel clusters interspersed between the annuli, particularly concentrated on the mid-lateral aspect.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; a secondary linear alignment of four smaller dark blobs is visible along the lateral-ventral margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple linear, high-intensity red and pink pixel streaks visible on the lower-left extremity, indicating fresh epidermal trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined 'marbled' pattern with extreme contrast between midnight-blue perimeters and light-blue/gray interiors across the visible surface.
